slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: 【您成功加入王女克琳希德阵营，阶段任务一完成。】
【开启信任值系统，王女克琳希德当前信任值：20%】
【信任值提升至100%便可完成本次所有阶段任务。】
（骗取信任？这个我擅长啊！）
齐格飞眼神一亮，这是专业对口了呀。
【警告！王女克琳希德身负太阳神的加护，欺人之谈对其效果非常有限。】
（哦，那没事了……）
齐格飞用指尖敲了敲长桌，将大家的注意力聚拢了过来，还有些话他必须得事先讲好：
“我会帮你们，但有两个条件。”
卡塔丽娜咽了口唾沫，她想起了昨晚齐格飞的戏言。
（该不会是要我吧？）
齐格飞察觉了到了卡塔丽娜的异常，但他没理会这个思维跳跃的女骑士，继续说了下去：
“第一，我不会以梅兰的身份提供帮助，准确来说一般情况下我甚至不会露面。“
主要是因为怂，他怕真正的梅兰家族派人来砍死他这个冒牌货。
“第二，我不会直接介入任何战争，只会在幕后为你们出谋划策。”
主要是因为菜，如今圣剑已经断了，就他那两下子恐怕连罗兰的马都打不过。
“原因……你们都懂的吧？”
齐格飞神色异常严肃，仿佛在暗示一个巨大的秘密。
“嗯，我们能理解。”
坦白说，齐格飞不知道他们都理解了些啥。但强者的一大好处就是他们只要摆出高深莫测的样子，底下的人就会自己开始脑补。
现在该想想怎么提升克琳希德的信任度了。
齐格飞非常懊恼为什么没有听从妹妹的安利多玩玩美少女游戏，说不准就能学到攻略克琳希德这类角色的窍门呢。现在只能用笨办法了，多干活多做贡献，时间长了老板自然会信任你的。
用餐结束后，罗兰骑着他的魇驹赶往他们原本藏身的洞窟，那里还有一行人的行李以及一支十人左右的留守部队。
其中还有克琳希德的另一发小，魔法师达伦。
据众人所说，达伦的魔法天赋堪称天才中的天才，尤其擅长风元素魔法。他的年龄在队伍中是最小的才15岁，但实力却足以匹敌卡塔丽娜。
齐格飞根据描述，在脑海里描绘出了达伦的形象——高傲臭屁的少年天才，谁都不放在眼里那种。
本来这个年龄段的小孩都有些中二，成天以为自己是最特殊的，如果恰好还有些天赋的话更是了不得，眼睛能长到天花板上去。
这种刻板印象来自于齐格飞自己，他还没被社会毒打前就是那种老子天下第一的类型。
所以当这位身高不足一米六的少年天才出现在齐格飞的眼前时，他属实吃了一惊。
“你就是达伦？”
“唔，见过勇者大人。嗯？现在还不是勇者，非常抱歉。应该怎么称呼才好，齐格飞？不不不不，那也太僭越了，像我这样的人怎么能对未来的勇者直呼其名。唔，我真是太失礼了。”
这位长得比女生还楚楚可怜的天才少年，正因为不知如何称呼齐格飞陷入了慌乱中。
齐格飞扭过头看向一旁的罗兰，神色颇为精彩。
content_en:
[You have successfully joined the camp of Princess Clynxide, and the first phase of the mission has been completed. 】
[Enable the trust value system, the current trust value of Queen Clinhide: 20%]
[If the trust value is increased to 100%, all stages of this mission can be completed. 】
(Defraud trust? I’m good at this!)
Siegfried's eyes lit up, this was a professional counterpart.
【warn! Princess Crynhild is protected by the Sun God, and deception has very limited effect on her. 】
(Oh, that’s okay...)
Siegfried tapped the long table with his fingertips, gathering everyone's attention. There were some things he had to say in advance:
"I will help you, but there are two conditions."
Katarina swallowed, remembering Siegfried's joke last night.
(You want me, right?)
Siegfried noticed something unusual about Katarina, but he ignored the jumping female knight and continued:
"First, I will not provide help as Mei Lan. To be precise, I will not even show up under normal circumstances."
Mainly because of cowardice, he was afraid that the real Meilan family would send people to kill him, the fake.
"Second, I will not directly intervene in any war. I will only advise you behind the scenes."
Mainly because of the dish. Now that the holy sword has been broken, he might not even be able to beat Roland's horse with his two blows.
"The reason... you all understand, right?"
Siegfried looked extremely serious, as if hinting at a huge secret.
"Yeah, we understand."
Frankly speaking, Siegfried didn't know what they understood. But one of the great advantages of strong people is that as long as they act inscrutable, the people below will start to figure it out.
Now it's time to think about how to improve Crynhild's trust.
Siegfried was very upset as to why he didn't listen to his sister, Amway, and play the girl game more. Maybe he could learn the secret to defeating characters like Clinhilde. Now I can only use stupid methods. Work more and contribute more. Over time, your boss will naturally trust you.
After the meal, Roland rode his nightmare horse and rushed to the cave where they originally hid. There were also a group of luggage and a remaining force of about ten people.
Among them is another one of Clinhide's little ones, the magician Darren.
According to everyone, Darren's magic talent is considered a genius among geniuses, and he is especially good at wind element magic. He is the youngest in the team at only 15 years old, but his strength is enough to rival Katarina.
Based on the description, Siegfried painted an image of Darren in his mind—a arrogant and stinky young genius who was not looked down upon by anyone.
Originally, children of this age group are a bit of a middle school student. They always think that they are the most special. If they happen to have some talents, it will be even more extraordinary. Their eyes can grow to the ceiling.
This stereotype comes from Siegfried himself. Before he was beaten up by society, he was the type who was the best in the world.
So when this young genius, who was less than 1.6 meters tall, appeared in front of Siegfried, he was really surprised.
"Are you Darren?"
"Well, I have met the hero. Huh? I am not a hero yet. I am very sorry. How should I call him, Siegfried? No, no, no, no, that is too transgressive. How can a person like me call the future hero by his first name. Well, I am really rude."
This genius boy, who was even more pitiful than a girl, was in a panic just because he didn't know how to call Siegfried.
Siegfried turned his head and looked at Roland, his expression quite exciting.
